title: toast sentence case generic tone
name: Toast sentence case generic tone — Spectrum
rule: Sentence case, no period on a single sentence; instructive/neutral tone (not playful, celebratory, or promotional/upsell); generic language (no filenames/usernames/folders unless necessary).
pass_when: Sentence case; single sentence has no period; tone is instructive/neutral; names/files omitted unless necessary.
fail_when: Title Case; period on a single sentence; playful/celebratory/upsell; unnecessary filenames/usernames/folders.
overview: Toast copy uses sentence case, neutral tone, and generic wording without unnecessary names.
apply_when: Writing confirmation, info, or low-priority alert toast messages.
not_when: Marketing banners, celebratory campaigns, or detailed error dialogs that need specifics.
agent_hint: Write sentence-case neutral toast copy; skip periods on single sentences and unnecessary names.
description: Spectrum toast writing stays in sentence case, drops the period on a single sentence, keeps an instructive or neutral tone, and uses generic language unless a filename, username, or folder is necessary. Title Case, playful or promotional voice, and unnecessary identity details fight the low-priority status surface. Keep copy calm and generic on toasts; move celebratory or upsell language elsewhere.
do_not_claim: General UI sentence-case already filed (Actions/Forms) as a delete of this toast row.
